噗芙的星之碎片大冒險・台北篇

CT5812701 材料物化性分析 — 期中考前的選修複習遊戲（不計分）。2025 年期中考的 22 組考題被封印在「星之碎片」裡，散落在台北市 22 個地標。

1. 開始之前

  • 使用手機（iPhone Safari 或 Android Chrome）開啟遊戲網頁，建議先按左上角的「全螢幕」。
  • 第一次進入地圖時，請允許網頁使用位置資訊；拍照與 AR 任務會要求相機，搖晃與指向任務會要求動作與方向感測器。
  • 本遊戲為個人賽、不需登入或輸入學號。所有進度、照片與筆記只存在你自己的手機瀏覽器中。

2. 遊戲流程

  1. 走路開花：地圖會記錄你的路線，每走 25 公尺種下一朵星之花。
  2. 抵達地標：進入地標約 60 公尺範圍內（會依 GPS 精度放寬），圖示會發光，點選後按「進入關卡」。
  3. 現場任務：依地標不同，可能是拍照、AR 吸入、搖晃、散步、指向、接星星或光圈時機任務。
  4. 解開考題：完成任務即獲得星之碎片並顯示考題。遊戲只提供題目、不提供答案，你可以在筆記欄寫下解題過程。
  5. 最終關卡：收集 15 片碎片後，到台科大精誠雕塑挑戰墨霧獸。

3. 三個世界與 22 個地標

粒子平原（粒徑分析）7 站、水晶洞窟（晶體與 XRD）9 站、電子天空（SEM／EDS）6 站。每個世界第一片碎片會讓噗芙獲得新的「複製能力」造型。

4. 任務類型

任務玩法沒有感測器時
📷 拍照拍下指定景物（照片只存在手機）—
✨ AR 吸入用相機畫面找到碎片，放進準星後按住「吸入」改用插畫背景
🫨 搖晃用力搖晃手機直到量表滿格快速連點畫面
🚶 散步在地標附近步行指定距離—
🧭 指向手機頂端指向指定地標 2 秒拖曳指針
⭐ 接星星左右移動噗芙接住星星、避開墨霧—
🔦 光圈時機電子束經過光圈中央時按 A—

5. 操作

  • 地圖：單指拖曳移動、雙指縮放；按「定位」回到自己的位置。
  • 螢幕搖桿（設定中開啟）：左側類比搖桿移動地圖或角色，右側 A 決定／吸入、B 返回。
  • 鍵盤預設：方向鍵／WASD 移動、空白鍵或 Enter = A、Esc = B、M 選單、B 圖鑑、E／Q 縮放、L 定位、P 暫停。可在「設定 → 自訂按鍵」修改。

6. 設定

  • 背景音樂（預設關閉）：開啟後依場景切換日常、學院與戰鬥三種風格的配樂；也可在「音樂選單」指定單一曲目（8 首）。音效（預設開啟）；可分別調整音量。
  • 繪圖：WebGPU 硬體（預設）或軟體；不支援 WebGPU 的裝置會自動切換為軟體。
  • 畫質：流暢（預設）、標準、高（2K 以上）。手機發熱或耗電時請選「流暢」。
  • 螢幕搖桿（預設關閉）、劇情提示（預設開啟）、語言（中文／中文+English／English）、全螢幕、暫停、重新開始。

7. 存檔與讀檔

遊戲會自動存檔；另有 3 個手動存檔欄位。換手機或清除瀏覽器資料前，請用「匯出存檔檔案」備份，之後可用「匯入存檔檔案」還原。

8. 安全守則

  • 請在白天、結伴前往；過馬路與騎車時請勿看手機。
  • 寺廟內請保持安靜、勿使用閃光燈；餐廳與市場請勿妨礙營業與排隊動線。
  • 不需要消費才能完成任務。

Puff's Star Shard Adventure — Taipei Chapter

CT5812701 Physical and Chemical Analysis on Materials — an optional, ungraded review game before the midterm. The 22 question sets of the 2025 midterm are sealed inside Star Shards scattered over 22 Taipei landmarks.

1. Before you start

  • Open the game page on your phone (iPhone Safari or Android Chrome) and tap Full Screen first.
  • When the map opens, allow location access. Photo and AR missions ask for the camera; shake and compass missions ask for motion & orientation sensors.
  • Individual play — no login or student ID. Progress, photos and notes stay in your own phone's browser.

2. How to play

  1. Walk & bloom: the map traces your route and plants a Star Flower every 25 m.
  2. Reach a landmark: within about 60 m (relaxed by GPS accuracy) its icon glows. Tap it, then Enter Stage.
  3. Field mission: photo, AR inhale, shake, stroll, compass, star-catch or aperture-timing.
  4. Unseal the question: clear the mission to collect the shard and reveal the question. Questions only — no answers. Use the notes box for your working.
  5. Final stage: with 15 shards, challenge Murk at the NTUST Jing-Cheng sculpture.

3. Three worlds, 22 landmarks

Particle Plains (particle sizing) 7 stages, Crystal Caverns (crystals & XRD) 9 stages, Electron Sky (SEM / EDS) 6 stages. The first shard of each world gives Puff a new Copy Ability outfit.

4. Mission types

MissionWhat to doWithout sensors
📷 PhotoPhotograph the target (stays on your phone)—
✨ AR inhaleFind the shard in the camera view, centre it, hold INHALEIllustrated background
🫨 ShakeShake the phone until the gauge is fullTap rapidly
🚶 StrollWalk the given distance near the landmark—
🧭 CompassPoint the top of the phone at a landmark for 2 sDrag the needle
⭐ Star catchMove Puff to catch stars and dodge murk—
🔦 Aperture timingPress A as the beam crosses the aperture—

5. Controls

  • Map: drag with one finger, pinch to zoom; Locate re-centres on you.
  • On-screen joystick (enable in Settings): left stick moves the map or Puff; A = confirm / inhale, B = back.
  • Keyboard defaults: arrows / WASD move, Space or Enter = A, Esc = B, M menu, B book, E / Q zoom, L locate, P pause. Change them in Settings → Key bindings.

6. Settings

  • Music (off by default): follows the scene — everyday, academic and battle styles — or pick one of the 8 tracks in the Music menu. Sound effects (on by default). Separate volume sliders.
  • Rendering: WebGPU hardware (default) or software; devices without WebGPU switch to software automatically.
  • Quality: Smooth (default), Standard, High (2K+). Pick Smooth if the phone gets warm.
  • On-screen joystick (off), story hints (on), language (中文 / 中文+English / English), full screen, pause, restart.

7. Save & load

The game autosaves, and there are 3 manual slots. Before changing phones or clearing browser data, use Export save file; restore it later with Import save file.

8. Safety

  • Go in daylight and with friends; never look at the phone while crossing streets or riding.
  • Be quiet and use no flash inside temples; don't block queues in restaurants and markets.
  • No purchase is needed to clear any mission.

那年秋天，天空下起了星星。That autumn, the sky rained stars.

星之庭園裡，知識星燈靜靜發著光。In the Star Garden, the Lamp of Knowledge glowed softly.

墨霧獸一口咬下——星燈碎成了二十二片。Murk bit down — and the Lamp shattered into twenty-two pieces.

碎片劃過夜空，落在台北的街角。The shards streaked across the night and fell onto the corners of Taipei.

每一片，都封印著去年的試煉。Each one seals a trial from last year.

答案，就在那裡。The answers are out there.

帶上手機，和噗芙一起出發吧！Grab your phone — let's go with Puff!

我是噗芙！我能把東西吸進臉頰裡，學會它的「複製能力」。I'm Puff! I can stuff things into my cheeks and copy their abilities.

22 片星之碎片散落在台北。走到地標附近，地圖上的圖示就會發光。22 Star Shards are scattered around Taipei. Walk near a landmark and its icon will glow.

一路走一路開花——每走 25 公尺，就會種下一朵星之花。Flowers bloom as you walk — one Star Flower every 25 m.

完成現場任務，就能解開碎片裡的考題。考題不計分，盡情複習吧！Clear the field mission to unseal the question inside. Nothing is graded — just review!

過馬路時請收起手機、注意安全喔！Put the phone away when crossing streets. Stay safe!

拍下指定的景物，證明你真的在現場！Photograph the target to prove you are really here!

舉起手機找到漂浮的碎片，把它放進準星，按住「吸入」！Raise your phone, find the floating shard, put it in the reticle and hold INHALE!

用力搖晃手機！Shake your phone hard!

（沒有感測器？連續快速點擊畫面也可以）(No motion sensor? Tap the screen rapidly instead.)

在地標附近散步 {m} 公尺。Stroll {m} m around the landmark.

把手機頂端對準「{to}」的方向，維持 2 秒。Point the top of your phone toward "{to}" and hold for 2 s.

手動模式：拖曳指針指向「{to}」。Manual mode: drag the needle toward "{to}".

左右移動噗芙，接住 {n} 顆星星，避開墨霧！Move Puff left/right, catch {n} stars and dodge the Murk blobs!

電子束掃過光圈中央時，按下 A！命中 3 次。Press A when the beam passes the centre of the aperture! Hit 3 times.

第一階段：接住星星，躲開墨霧！Phase 1: catch stars, dodge the murk!

第二階段：對準光圈，發射電子束！Phase 2: line up the aperture and fire the beam!

第三階段：按住吸入，把墨霧獸吸乾淨！Phase 3: hold INHALE and suck up Murk!

一蘭 台灣台北本店Ichiran Taipei Main Store

拍下店門口的紅色招牌或燈籠。Photograph the red signboard or lantern at the entrance.

豚骨湯為什麼混混的？因為裡面懸浮著好多小到不會沉下去的油滴和膠質！Why is tonkotsu broth cloudy? Countless droplets too tiny to ever settle are floating in it!

小到不會沉下去……碎片就藏在這片「混濁」裡！Too tiny to settle… the shard is hiding in that cloudiness!

吸飽了！噗芙學會了「篩網」能力！Got it! Puff learned the Sieve ability!

阜杭豆漿Fu Hang Soy Milk

在排隊人潮附近找到漂浮的碎片並吸入。Find the shard floating near the queue and inhale it.

一杯豆漿裡有幾十億顆小顆粒。如果要一顆一顆數，還要量大小……A cup of soy milk holds billions of tiny particles. Counting them one by one and sizing each…

讓它們一顆顆穿過小孔，用電流來數？好像在哪裡學過！Squeeze them through a tiny hole and count with electricity? I think we learned that!

燒餅油條加碎片，完美的早餐！Clay-oven roll, fried dough and a shard — the perfect breakfast!

鬍鬚張魯肉飯（美食文化館）Formosa Chang Braised Pork Rice (Food Culture Hall)

把手機當成篩網用力搖！Use your phone as a sieve and shake it!

米粒、肉末、醬汁……大大小小全混在一起。Rice grains, minced pork, sauce… big and small, all mixed together.

那就一層一層篩！從最大的篩孔開始！Then sieve them layer by layer, starting from the biggest opening!

每一層都乾乾淨淨，篩分析完成！Every layer sorted — sieve analysis complete!

南門市場Nanmen Market

拍下大小不同的豆子、米或乾貨。Photograph beans, rice or dried goods of different sizes.

紅豆、綠豆、糯米、乾香菇……這裡簡直是粒徑分布展覽館！Red beans, mung beans, sticky rice, dried shiitake… a living exhibition of particle size distributions!

把它們累積起來畫成曲線，就能看出最大的那顆有多大！Pile them up into a cumulative curve and we can tell how big the biggest ones are!

曲線畫好了，碎片也到手！Curve plotted, shard collected!

阿宗麵線Ay-Chung Flour-Rice Noodle

在附近散步，讓麵線稍微放涼。Take a short stroll while the noodles cool down.

細細的麵線、切段的大腸、柴魚片……尺寸差好多！Thin noodles, chopped intestines, bonito flakes… such different sizes!

分布越寬，曲線就越平。走一走，讓我好好想想！The wider the distribution, the flatter the curve. Let me think while we walk!

走完了！這次的分布我看懂了！Walk complete! I can read this distribution now!

台大牛莊NTU Beef Village

接住慢慢沉下去的牛肉湯顆粒！Catch the particles slowly sinking in the beef broth!

牛肉湯放久了，小碎屑會慢慢沉到碗底。Leave the beef soup alone and little bits slowly sink to the bottom.

球形、單獨、慢慢掉……這就是斯托克斯定律的世界！Spherical, isolated, falling slowly… welcome to the world of Stokes' law!

一顆都沒漏掉！Didn't miss a single one!

台北車站（南二門）Taipei Main Station (South Gate 2)

把手機對準台北 101 的方向。Point your phone toward Taipei 101.

火車準時進站，顆粒也準時落地——30 公分，花了 90 秒！Trains arrive on time, and so do particles — 30 cm in 90 seconds!

那它有多大呢？我們得用公式算算看！So how big is it? Time to crunch the formula!

方位對了，計算也對了（大概）！Right direction, right calculation (probably)!

艋舺龍山寺Bangka Lungshan Temple

拍下重複出現的圖案（窗花、屋瓦或石雕），請勿使用閃光燈，保持安靜。Photograph a repeating pattern (window lattice, roof tiles or carvings). No flash, please keep quiet.

仔細看窗花：同一個圖樣不斷重複。重複的「點」排起來，就是晶格。Look at the window lattice: the same motif repeats again and again. The repeating points form a lattice.

那最小的重複單元，就叫做……單位晶胞！And the smallest repeating unit is called… the unit cell!

噗芙學會了「繞射」能力！Puff learned the Diffraction ability!

饒河街觀光夜市Raohe Street Night Market

在胡椒餅攤附近找到碎片並吸入。Find the shard near the pepper-bun stall and inhale it.

包子、胡椒餅一顆顆堆起來，堆得最緊密的方式只有兩種。Stack buns as tightly as possible and there are only two ways to do it.

ABAB……還是 ABCABC？我要先吃一顆再決定！ABAB… or ABCABC? Let me eat one before deciding!

好燙好香！碎片到手！Hot and peppery! Shard collected!

國父紀念館映池Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall Reflecting Pool

把手機對準台北 101 的方向，看看水面倒影。Point your phone toward Taipei 101 and look at its reflection in the pool.

入射角等於反射角。但 X 光繞射量的是入射光束和繞射光束之間的夾角。Angle in equals angle out. But in XRD we measure the angle between the incident and diffracted beams.

還要把 Kβ 濾掉，只留下單一波長！And filter out Kβ to keep a single wavelength!

倒影和碎片，一起收藏！Reflection and shard, both collected!

臺北霞海城隍廟Taipei Xia-Hai City God Temple

拍下廟門或月老神像前的紅線（請勿使用閃光燈）。Photograph the temple gate or the red threads by the Matchmaker (no flash).

月下老人牽紅線，講究「門當戶對」。繞射也一樣：波長要和晶面間距差不多才行。The Matchmaker ties red threads between good matches. Diffraction too: the wavelength must match the plane spacing.

紫外線太長、無線電波更長……配對失敗！Ultraviolet is too long, radio waves even longer… no match!

配對成功！碎片收下了！It's a match! Shard collected!

行天宮Xingtian Temple

把手機對準台北 101 的方向。Point your phone toward Taipei 101.

電子從外層掉回內層，會放出特定能量的 X 光：K、L、M 殼層，一階一階。When electrons drop to inner shells they emit X-rays of specific energy: K, L, M shells, step by step.

從 M 掉到 K 是 Kβ，從 L 掉到 K 是 Kα……那 Lα 呢？M to K is Kβ, L to K is Kα… so what about Lα?

能階排好了，碎片到手！Energy levels sorted — shard collected!

國立中正紀念堂National Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall

在自由廣場上散步 {m} 公尺。Stroll {m} m across Liberty Square.

廣場的地磚是一個大格子。在晶胞裡切一刀，就是一個晶面。The square's paving is one big grid. Slice a unit cell and you get a crystal plane.

(102)：先找截距，再取倒數！(102): find the intercepts, then take the reciprocals!

晶面切好了！Plane sliced!

台北 101「LOVE」裝置藝術Taipei 101 "LOVE" Sculpture

拍下 LOVE 裝置藝術。Photograph the LOVE sculpture.

把鎂摻進氧化鋅，晶格會被撐開或擠壓，繞射峰也會跟著移動、變寬。Dope Mg into ZnO and the lattice is strained — diffraction peaks shift and broaden.

摻最多的是哪一條？用愛……和峰形來判斷！Which pattern has the most Mg? Judge with love… and peak shape!

I ♥ XRD！I ♥ XRD!

台北大巨蛋（捷運國父紀念館站 5 號出口）Taipei Dome (MRT Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall Exit 5)

舉起手機對準巨蛋，吸入碎片。Aim at the Dome and inhale the shard.

巨蛋屋頂的鋼構是規則的網格。網格間距變了，繞射角就會變。The Dome's steel roof is a regular grid. Change the spacing and the diffraction angle changes.

2θ 變大，d 就……變小！布拉格先生說的！2θ goes up, so d goes… down! Mr. Bragg said so!

全壘打！碎片飛進來了！Home run! The shard flew right in!

小巨蛋（捷運站 3 號出口）Taipei Arena (MRT Exit 3)

用力搖晃手機，把光子的能量凍結下來！Shake your phone to freeze the photon's energy!

冰也是六方晶系，和氧化鋅一樣。現在，算算一顆 Cu-Kα 光子帶多少能量。Ice is hexagonal, just like ZnO. Now, how much energy does one Cu-Kα photon carry?

E 等於 h 乘 c 除以 λ……單位要小心！E equals h times c over λ… careful with the units!

冰冷又閃亮的碎片！A cold, sparkling shard!

寶可夢中心台北Pokémon Center Taipei

接住從樣品彈回來的電子星星！Catch the electron stars bouncing back from the sample!

電子打進樣品，有的彈回來（背向散射電子），有的鑽得更深，激發出 X 光。Electrons hit the sample: some bounce back (backscattered), others go deeper and excite X-rays.

彈性碰撞還是非彈性碰撞？接住就知道！Elastic or inelastic? Catch them and find out!

噗芙學會了「電子束」能力！Puff learned the Beam ability!

HOOTERS 美式餐廳 信義店Hooters Xinyi

電子束掃過光圈中央時按下 A！Press A when the beam crosses the aperture!

貓頭鷹的大眼睛收得到更多光。SEM 的光圈則是一個小孔，擋掉偏離的電子。An owl's big eyes gather more light. In SEM, the aperture is a small hole that blocks stray electrons.

孔越小，景深越深、像差越小……但電流也越少！Smaller hole: deeper focus, fewer aberrations… but less current!

光圈對準了！Aperture aligned!

一蘭 台灣台北別館Ichiran Taipei Annex

在附近散步 {m} 公尺。Stroll {m} m nearby.

一蘭的每個座位都是一個小隔間，就像電子在樣品裡的「作用體積」。Every Ichiran seat is a little booth — like the electron interaction volume inside a sample.

能量越高、原子序越小、密度越小，隔間就越大！公式裡每個符號是什麼呢？Higher energy, lower Z, lower density — bigger booth! What does each symbol in the formula mean?

隔間量好了，拉麵也吃飽了！Booth measured, ramen finished!

松山文創園區Songshan Cultural and Creative Park

拍下一扇會反射或折射光的玻璃窗。Photograph a glass window that reflects or bends light.

舊菸廠的玻璃窗會彎折光線。SEM 的電磁透鏡也會彎折電子。The old factory's windows bend light. SEM's electromagnetic lenses bend electrons.

物體在兩倍焦距外面……成像要畫三條光線！Object beyond twice the focal length… draw three rays to find the image!

透鏡成像，清清楚楚！Lens image, crystal clear!

四四南村Four Four South Village

對準眷村的屋頂，把碎片吸進來。Aim at the village rooftops and inhale the shard.

高低起伏的屋頂，看的是表面形貌；不同材質的牆，看的是成分對比。Up-and-down rooftops show topography; different wall materials show compositional contrast.

二次電子看形貌，背向散射電子看原子序！Secondary electrons for topography, backscattered electrons for atomic number!

形貌、成分，一次看清！Topography and composition, all at once!

國立臺灣科技大學 精誠雕塑NTUST "Jing-Cheng" Sculpture

打倒墨霧獸，奪回最後的碎片！Defeat Murk and win back the final shard!

咕嚕嚕……最後一片碎片是我的！Grrrlll… the last shard is MINE!

它把碎片吞進肚子裡了！用 EDS 看看它到底吃了什麼元素！It swallowed the shard! Use EDS to see which elements it ate!

大家，借我力量！Everyone, lend me your power!

墨霧獸散開了，星燈重新亮起！Murk dissolves — the Lamp shines again!
